data.narrative:
Occam is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Ana Montero Horas and Andre Marques-Smith that has raised $14M to date. The valuation framework draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals within the Biotech & Health sector.

Of three triangulation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $14M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $35M. The Peer-Median approach could not be deployed: while 7 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables—insufficient for reliable median anchoring. Public-Comp Anchoring was inapplicable because the target's revenue is not on file; the public sector median P/S of 6.6x across three biotech tickers cannot be operationalized without this input.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $30M to $40M, centered on $35M. This range reflects limited methodological coverage—reliant on a single directional method. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficiently comparable private peers at seed stage and the lack of revenue disclosure, which would enable cross-check via public multiples. Additional diligence on burn rate, pipeline stage, and team track record would refine conviction.
